earlier_linux_run.cause: Synthetic parent directories inherited umask 077 and violated required public 0755 metadata.
earlier_linux_run.correction: Fixture creation explicitly chmods new directories; existing private parents and production checks are unchanged.

limits: Synthetic trees, declared inventories and inert child commands only. No installed image, Studio process, hardware or SD is accessed.
Linux root uses real ownership, xattrs, UID/GID 1000 and flock. Boot/mountinfo/NSS evidence is injected; no fresh /run or real reboot is established.
A real inert Python exec retains SH and excludes EX until it exits. The application and helper guards, legacy writers, actual service lifecycles and drains remain unqualified.
Supervisor PID1, cgroup and candidate adapters are inert. Worker and descendant states are simulated; no systemd unit is started by these tests.
The runtime requires a new complete pinned factory bundle and support including Python dist-packages, plus Studio guards and image installation. The existing TEST profile remains unchanged.
Ready only asserts completed factory admission. IPC readiness, pairing, time/country, Wi-Fi and physical display qualification remain separate.
macOS explicitly substitutes numeric ownership and the Linux xattr API; its two Linux root cases are skipped.
Both native attempts are preserved. The successful attempt uses corrected fixture metadata under the same umask 077; no production guard is relaxed.
